We are hiring Full Stack MERN developers to build modern, responsive web applications using React, Next.js, Node.js, and TypeScript. Multiple openings for freshers with strong personal projects and developers with up to two years of experience.

You will build reusable UI components, design and implement REST APIs, work with SQL/NoSQL databases, and collaborate with the engineering team on real-world products.

Key responsibilities

Build responsive, reusable UI components using React.js and Next.js
Design and develop REST APIs using Node.js and Express.js
Integrate frontend applications with backend services and third-party APIs
Work with SQL or NoSQL databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB)
Write clean, well-documented, and maintainable code
Debug issues and participate in code reviews
Collaborate with the team using Git and GitHub
Requirements

Strong understanding of modern JavaScript (ES6+) and TypeScript
Hands-on experience with React.js and Next.js
Experience building REST APIs with Node.js and Express.js
Familiarity with HTML5, CSS3, and Tailwind CSS or Bootstrap
Understanding of asynchronous programming and state management
Experience with Git and GitHub
Freshers must demonstrate skills via GitHub repositories, full-stack projects, or live deployments
0–2 years of experience; freshers with strong projects encouraged
